name: How long does a typical drain cleaning service take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical drain cleaning service take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a drain cleaning service can vary depending on the severity and location of the clog. A simple fixture clog might be cleared in under an hour, while more complex main line blockages, especially those requiring hydro-jetting or camera inspection, could take several hours. Factors like pipe age, the type of obstruction, and ease of access also play a role. Our technicians will assess the situation upon arrival and provide an estimated timeframe for completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Drain cleaning time varies from under an hour for simple clogs to several hours for complex main line issues, depending on severity, location, and method used.
